title: Initiate
tagline: AI iWatch app that manages your crypto via voice with seamless Web3 UIs.
description:
Initiate is an advanced AI-powered iWatch app that brings full Web3 intelligence to your wrist. It seamlessly connects your wallet address to the blockchain, allowing you to view balances, prices, and transactions in real time with elegant, compact visualizations optimized for the Apple Watch display.

Driven by an integrated voice assistant and on-device AI reasoning, Initiate understands complex, natural commands like:

“Compare my ETH and USDC balances over the last week,”
“Keep only 0.01 ETH here and send the rest to vitalik.eth.”

The AI doesn’t just execute — it thinks, analyzes trends, and provides concise insights on your portfolio, transfers, and market movements.

With smooth performance, intuitive micro-interactions, and secure blockchain execution, Initiate transforms your iWatch into a smart Web3 command center, blending AI reasoning, voice control, and decentralized finance into one fluid experience.
how_its_made: Initiate is built using SwiftUI to create a smooth, native experience on the iWatch, optimized for clarity and speed on the small display. It connects to a Next.js backend that handles wallet communication, blockchain queries, and secure transaction routing. The app’s intelligence comes from Anannas.ai, which powers natural voice understanding, complex reasoning, and smart execution of Web3 actions — enabling the watch to think, analyze, and act like a true on-wrist crypto assistant.
